title: Dolphin's spearsmp ResourcePack
description: resource pack for Dolphin's spearsmp plugin adding custom textures for 8 spears Blood, Speed, Saturation, Dragon, Emerald, Void, Sculk, and Health.
body:
Resource pack for https://modrinth.com/plugin/dolphins-spearsmp-plugin.

This resource pack adds all the textures required for the plugin listed above, it makes all spears Blood, Speed, Saturation, Dragon, Emerald, Void, Sculk, and Health have custom textures for a better playing experience. 

This resource pack is needed by the plugin or else players will see just a cube.
